questions.question: You need to drink 8 glasses of water a day to stay hydrated.
questions.answer: False - Hydration needs vary, and water from food and other drinks also counts.

questions.question: Cracking your knuckles causes arthritis.
questions.answer: False - Studies show no link between knuckle cracking and arthritis; the sound comes from gas bubbles popping in the joints.

questions.question: Drinking a hot drink can make you sweat out toxins.
questions.answer: False - Sweat is mostly water and does not remove toxins; detoxification is handled by the liver and kidneys.

questions.question: Eating spinach makes you stronger.
questions.answer: False - It was an advertising trick to sell more spinach.

questions.question: Being cold gives you a cold.
questions.answer: False - A cold is a virus and getting it is not directly related to the temperature outside.

questions.question: Shaving your hair makes it grow back thicker.
questions.answer: True - Shaving does not affect the thickness or texture of your hair, but it may appear thicker because of the blunt ends.

questions.question: Eating late at night causes weight gain.
questions.answer: True - It’s not just when you eat, but what you eat and how much. Late-night eating can lead to poor digestion and weight gain, especially high-calorie foods.

questions.question: You can train your brain to memorize better by sleeping on it.
questions.answer: True - Studies show that sleep can improve memory consolidation and learning processes, helping you remember better.

questions.question: Biting your nails can lead to brain damage.
questions.answer: False - Biting nails is a habit, but it does not cause brain damage.

questions.question: You can get the flu from being around someone wearing a face mask.
questions.answer: False - Face masks are designed to help prevent the spread of viruses, not to transmit them.

questions.question: Sugar causes hyperactivity in children.
questions.answer: False - Studies have found no scientific link between sugar consumption and hyperactivity.

questions.question: Humming to your plants makes them grow faster.
questions.answer: False - While plants respond to light and water, there is no scientific evidence that sound directly affects growth.

questions.question: The flu vaccine can give you the flu.
questions.answer: False - The flu vaccine contains inactivated viruses that cannot give you the flu.

questions.question: Drinking milk strengthens your bones and prevents osteoporosis.
questions.answer: True - While other factors are involved, calcium and vitamin D from milk contribute to bone health and can reduce the risk of osteoporosis.

questions.question: Eating carrots significantly improves your eyesight.
questions.answer: False - While carrots contain vitamin A, which supports eye health, they don’t drastically improve vision.
